title: 第19章 危机与机遇第20章 天香阁风波
content_zh:
就在叶霄尘还想着吃什么的时候，系统突然蹦了出来。
【叮！
触发紧急任务：王家的报复】
【任务说明：王家亡我之心不死，欲借林家纨绔之手除掉宿主。
若计划成功，可直接杀死叶霄尘，让叶林两家联姻失败。
若计划失败，叶霄尘必对林家纨绔做出出格之举，亦可离间叶林两家关系】
【任务要求：化解即将到来的危机】
【任务奖励（三选一）】：
大量培元丹（这是一批新鲜出炉的培元丹）
一阶顶级玄器二十柄（可定制款式与属性）
灵级功法《月华心经》（女性专用，修炼后可大幅提升修炼速度）
叶霄尘看着眼前浮现的系统面板，差点没忍住笑出声来。
这三个奖励，每一个都让他心动不已。
世上最痛苦的事，莫过于三个都想要的奖励摆在面前，却只能选一个。
他低声自语，眼中闪烁着兴奋的光芒。
培元丹？
他日后可是要养活一大家子，修炼丹药当然是越多越好。
可定制的一阶顶级玄器？
别的不说，二十柄这样的武器，足以让护卫队的整体战力提升一个档次。
至于《月华心经》……

叶霄尘脑海中浮现出林清瑶那张俏脸。
这丫头现在修炼的估计不是很好，若是有了这部灵级功法……
她会不会因此而高兴的跳起来呢？
如此，她胸前的波澜……
少主？叶龙见他突然停下脚步，疑惑地唤道。
没事。
叶霄尘回过神来，脸上带着掩饰不住的笑意，走，今天咱们好好尝尝这天香楼的手艺。
他大步流星地走向酒楼，心中暗道：这王家还真是贴心，生怕他日子过得太无聊，变着法子给他送机缘。
离开了王家，谁还会这么费心费力地着他？
想到这里，叶霄尘脸上的笑容更深了。
他已经迫不及待想要看看，王家这次又给他准备了什么。
天香阁内人声鼎沸，叶霄尘四人好不容易在二楼角落寻了张空桌。
小二，来个雅间。
叶龙沉声道。
客官对不住，今日雅间全满了。
小二赔着笑脸，您看这……
无妨。
叶霄尘随意摆手，就这儿吧。
content_en:
Just when Ye Xiaochen was still thinking about what to eat, the system suddenly popped up.
【bite!
Trigger emergency mission: Wang family’s revenge]
[Task description: The Wang family is determined to kill me, and wants to use the hands of the Lin family to get rid of the host.
If the plan succeeds, Ye Xiaochen can be killed directly and the marriage between Ye Lin and his family will fail.
If the plan fails, Ye Xiaochen will do something outrageous to the Lin family, and it will also drive a wedge between the Ye Lin family]
[Task requirement: resolve the upcoming crisis]
[Task reward (choose one from three)]:
A lot of Pei Yuan Dan (this is a fresh batch of Pei Yuan Dan)
Twenty first-level mysterious weapons (can be customized in style and attributes)
Spiritual level exercise "Moon Flower Heart Sutra" (only for women, after practice it can greatly increase the speed of practice)
Ye Xiaochen looked at the system panel that appeared in front of him and almost couldn't help laughing.
Each of these three rewards made him excited.
The most painful thing in the world is to have three rewards you want in front of you, but you can only choose one.
He whispered to himself, his eyes sparkling with excitement.
Pei Yuan Dan?
He will have to support a large family in the future, so the more pills he cultivates, the better.
A customizable first-level mysterious weapon?
Apart from anything else, twenty such weapons are enough to raise the overall combat power of the escort team to a higher level.
As for the "Moon Flower Heart Sutra"...
Lin Qingyao's pretty face appeared in Ye Xiaochen's mind.
This girl is probably not practicing very well now. If she had this spiritual level skill...
Will she jump with joy because of this?
So, the waves on her chest...
Young Master? Seeing him suddenly stop, Ye Long called out in confusion.
fine.
Ye Xiaochen came back to his senses, with a smile that couldn't be concealed on his face, "Let's go, let's try Tianxianglou's craftsmanship today."
He strode toward the restaurant, thinking to himself: The Wang family is really considerate. They are afraid that his life will be too boring, so they try their best to give him opportunities.
After leaving the Wang family, who would bother with him so much?
Thinking of this, the smile on Ye Xiaochen's face deepened.
He couldn't wait to see what the Wang family had prepared for him this time.
The Tianxiang Pavilion was buzzing with people, and Ye Xiaochen and the others finally found an empty table in the corner of the second floor.
Waiter, come to a private room.
Ye Long said in a deep voice.
I'm sorry, guest, but the private rooms are all full today.
The waiter is smiling, look at this...
No problem.
Ye Xiaochen waved his hand casually, "That's it."
